expected: oxygenator blood-side pressure drop increases at fixed RPM
solved total circuit flow decreases at fixed RPM
patient-directed ECMO flow decreases at fixed RPM
restoring clean hydraulic parameters returns the operating point approximately to baseline
effective membrane oxygen transfer decreases at fixed blood flow and gas settings
restoring clean gas-transfer parameters returns outputs approximately to baseline

explicit_non_rules: there is no universal oxygenator delta-P failure threshold in this contract
a high pressure gradient alone does not diagnose oxygenator failure
hydraulic obstruction and gas-transfer impairment are not required to progress one-for-one
the obstruction fraction is an internal model proxy, not a clinically measurable clot percentage
allowed_exceptions: complete sweep-gas loss is governed by CBC02
FdO2-only failure is a distinct mechanism
device-specific pressure-flow and gas-transfer magnitudes remain provisional
the current unified-patient venous gas limitation is outside this contract
gas-exchange failure may occur without a dramatic pressure-gradient rise
notes: CBC03 intentionally separates hydraulic and membrane-transfer branches so the test does not force one synthetic combined failure signature.
The 0.60 obstruction values and representative inlet conditions are regression fixtures, not clinical thresholds or treatment targets.
